commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

sessionId.description: A session's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints (never the provider's resume id), kept in lowercase.

anyOf.description: A session's composer draft as sent: the text typed and not sent, up to 65536 characters counted as UTF-16 code units; an empty draft is stored as none (null).

draft.description: The draft that replaces the stored one; null or an empty string clears it.
